responsibility: Implements the Rust AST-to-HIR lowering entry point for `AST::FormatArgs`, the special expression form behind `format_args!`-style formatting expansion. Its intended role in the lowering subsystem is to convert parsed format-argument AST into an HIR expression and eventually own HIR-level handling of formatting constructs for optimizations such as format-string flattening and constant inlining; in the current code it is only a placeholder that returns no HIR node and leaves this functionality to ordinary macro expansion instead.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line implementation of the `FormatArgsLowering` interface declared in the header. In this module pair, the `.cc` is the executable lowering stub for `AST::FormatArgs`, currently just providing `go(...)` and returning `nullptr`, whereas the `.h` only declares that dedicated lowerer class and entry point.
